source.description: Reviewed handmade raster felt-tip-marker process contact sheet.
source.notes: One face-free fortune cookie with one blank paper slip and three sparkles; no lettering, labels, arrows, numbers, UI, signatures, watermarks, sticker edge, badge frame, plate, takeout box, extra cookies, or decorative border.

process_strategy: Eight cumulative panels move from a sparse folded-cookie scaffold and reserved blank slip to one stable shell, fold opening, three sparkles, complete marker map, visible texture, and a finishing-only final.

progression_contract.blank_page_test: A beginner can copy Panel 1 in under two minutes using one wide oval, one center fold axis, two corner ticks, one open paper-slip route, three sparkle centers, and one broken shadow route.

anchor_map.early_mark: One wide oval with a vertical fold axis and two side-corner ticks
anchor_map.becomes: One folded fortune-cookie shell with two rounded wings and a centered pinched valley
anchor_map.fixed_relationship: The two wings stay balanced around the same center valley, and their lower tips remain fixed in every panel.
anchor_map.construction_note: Pale oval, axis, and ticks only in Panel 1; the shell silhouette begins in Panel 2.

anchor_map.early_mark: One open horizontal paper-slip route emerging to the right
anchor_map.becomes: One blank rectangular fortune slip tucked into the cookie opening
anchor_map.fixed_relationship: The slip remains attached inside the right half of the opening, points slightly upward, and never floats or gains text.
anchor_map.construction_note: Open route only until the blank slip contour is added in Panel 4.

anchor_map.early_mark: Three small sparkle centers and one broken shadow route
anchor_map.becomes: Exactly three yellow sparkles above the cookie and one navy broken shadow beneath it
anchor_map.fixed_relationship: The sparkles stay in a loose rising arc above the left wing and the shadow remains under both cookie tips.
anchor_map.construction_note: Placement marks only until Panels 4 and 5.

final_elements.name: cookie slip sparkle and ground placement guides
final_elements.description: One oval, fold axis, two corner ticks, one open slip route, three sparkle centers, and four short ground-placement dashes.

final_elements.name: folded fortune-cookie outer silhouette
final_elements.description: Two rounded cookie wings pinched into one centered lower valley with fixed left and right tips.

final_elements.name: central fold opening and inner rim
final_elements.description: One curved opening with one inner rim and two fold seams that explain the cookie construction.

final_elements.name: blank fortune slip and three sparkles
final_elements.description: One blank paper rectangle tucked into the right opening and exactly three four-point sparkles above the left wing.

final_elements.name: two highlights crumb marks and broken shadow
final_elements.description: Exactly two open-paper cookie highlights, five tiny crumb marks, and one broken ground shadow.

final_elements.name: black marker and complete gold coral yellow cream and navy color map
final_elements.description: Thick imperfect black outlines with golden cookie wings, coral inner fold, yellow sparkles, cream blank slip, and navy shadow.

final_elements.name: directional marker texture and small fold accents
final_elements.description: Visible marker streaks, established fold-depth accents, highlight edges, crumbs, and shadow texture.

overlap_reservations.foreground_element: blank fortune slip and three sparkles
overlap_reservations.background_lines_stop_before: The inner cookie rim stops at the reserved blank slip footprint, so the slip tucks into blank paper instead of covering a finished keeper line.

rejection_checks: Reject a detailed first panel, drifting wing tips or fold valley, or a blank slip that floats, changes angle, gains text, or disconnects from the opening.
Reject missing or extra cookies, slips, sparkles, highlights, crumbs, fold seams, or shadows after those elements appear.
Reject a final that introduces lettering, a face, plate, takeout box, extra cookie, color region, prop, sticker edge, or badge frame absent earlier.
Reject vector-like fills, glossy poster rendering, repeated faint-to-dark tracings, labels, arrows, numbers, text, signatures, or watermarks.
